en.whatIsIt: Potato early blight produces target-like circular dark brown lesions on foliage, impairing tuber sizing.
en.recommendedAction: Apply protectant fungicides (Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb) every 7-10 days under warm humid conditions.
en.immediateActionDesc: Spray protectant fungicide and avoid excessive nitrogen stress.

en.whatIsIt: Late blight can completely defoliate potato canopies in days and infect tubers with dry rot.
en.recommendedAction: Immediately spray Cymoxanil + Mancozeb or Dimethomorph formulations.
en.immediateActionDesc: Halt overhead irrigation and apply systemic curative fungicide immediately.

en.whatIsIt: The potato foliage is vigorous and free from pathological distress.
en.recommendedAction: Ensure regular hilling and balanced potassium application.
en.immediateActionDesc: Keep canopy aerated and scout fields weekly.

en.whatIsIt: Brown spot causes oval to circular dark brown spots across rice leaf blades and panicles, often linked to nutrient-deficient soil.
symptoms: Small cylindrical to oval brown spots
en.recommendedAction: Apply balanced potassium and spray Propiconazole or Hexaconazole.
en.immediateActionDesc: Correct soil potash deficiency and apply foliar fungicide.

en.whatIsIt: Rice blast is a destructive fungal disease causing diamond or spindle-shaped lesions with gray centers and brown margins.
symptoms: Gray or whitish center with reddish-brown border
en.recommendedAction: Apply Tricyclazole 75 WP (0.6g/L) or Isoprothiolane at the onset of lesions.
en.immediateActionDesc: Spray blast-specific fungicide and avoid excessive nitrogen application.

en.whatIsIt: Rice leaf shows clean erect blades with strong tillering and no fungal spots.
en.recommendedAction: Maintain optimal standing water depth (2-5cm) during active tillering.
en.immediateActionDesc: Maintain recommended water levels and split nitrogen doses.

en.whatIsIt: Early blight is a fungal disease caused by Alternaria solani affecting tomato and potato foliage. It manifests as dark concentric rings surrounded by yellow halos.
symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric target-rings
en.recommendedAction: Apply a copper-based fungicide (Copper Hydroxide) or Chlorothalonil early morning and ensure proper spacing for airflow.
en.immediateActionDesc: Prune infected bottom leaves and safely destroy them to halt fungal spore progression.

hi.whatIsIt: अगेती झुलसा (Early Blight) एक फफूंद जनित रोग है जो पत्तियों पर काले छल्लेदार धब्बे और पीलापन पैदा करता है।
symptoms: पत्तियों पर गहरे भूरे रंग के संकेंद्रित छल्ले
निचली पत्तियों से शुरू होता है
hi.recommendedAction: तुरंत कॉपर युक्त कवकनाशी का छिड़काव करें और पौधों के बीच हवा का प्रवाह सुनिश्चित करें।
hi.immediateActionDesc: रोगग्रस्त निचली पत्तियों को तुरंत काटकर नष्ट कर दें ताकि फफूंद न फैले।

te.whatIsIt: ముందస్తు మచ్చ తెగులు ఆకులపై గోధుమ రంగు వలయాలు మరియు పసుపు రంగు మచ్చలను కలిగిస్తుంది.
te.recommendedAction: వెంటనే రాగి ఆధారిత శిలీంధ్ర సంహారిణి (కాపర్ హైడ్రాక్సైడ్) పిచికారీ చేయండి.
te.immediateActionDesc: తెగులు సోకిన దిగువ ఆకులను కత్తిరించి నాశనం చేయండి.

ta.whatIsIt: ஆரம்பகால கருகல் நோய் இலைகளில் அடர் பழுப்பு நிற வளையங்களையும் மஞ்சள் புள்ளிகளையும் உருவாக்குகிறது.
symptoms: இலைகளில் அடர் பழுப்பு நிற வட்ட வடிவ புள்ளிகள்
ta.immediateActionDesc: நோய் பரவாமல் தடுக்க பாதிக்கப்பட்ட கீழ் இலைகளை வெட்டி அழிக்கவும்.

en.whatIsIt: Late blight is a destructive water-mold pathogen causing large, irregular water-soaked lesions that turn dark brown and rot rapidly.
symptoms: White fuzzy mold on underside of leaves in wet weather
en.recommendedAction: Apply systemic fungicides like Metalaxyl or Mancozeb immediately. Avoid sprinkler irrigation.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply systemic fungicide within 12 hours and remove collapsing vines.

hi.whatIsIt: पछेती झुलसा (Late Blight) बहुत तेजी से फैलने वाला रोग है जिससे पत्तियां सड़ने और सूखने लगती हैं।
symptoms: पत्तियों पर बड़े अनियमित काले धब्बे
hi.recommendedAction: तुरंत मैंकोजेब या मेटालेक्सिल कवकनाशी का छिड़काव करें।
hi.immediateActionDesc: 12 घंटे के भीतर दवा का छिड़काव करें और खराब शाखाओं को हटाएं।
